display_name: Snapdeal formula pattern — Commission Summary by Transaction Type
formula_sql:
SELECT
  transaction_type,
  COUNT(*) AS records,
  SUM(total_commission_amount) AS total_commission,
  SUM(tax_amount) AS total_gst,
  SUM(courier_fee) AS courier,
  SUM(marketing_fee) AS marketing,
  SUM(payment_collection_fee) AS payment_coll
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_commission
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY transaction_type
ORDER BY records DESC;
